Campaign baseline: AE3dAsymResSeparableV2, lr=1e-4, patience=20, weight_decay=dropout_rate=noise_std=0
Add SE channel recalibration (SEBlock3D) after every encoder stage of the champion AsymResSeparableV2
Add CBAM spatial attention at the bottleneck (128x2x8x8), on top of champion's SE
Ablation: keep champion's SE only on enc3/enc4 (remove se1/se2)
Further ablation: keep champion's SE only on enc4 (remove se3 too)
Replace champion's 2 explicit anisotropic MaxPools with learnable depthwise strided convs
Nonlinear FC bottleneck: fc_enc/fc_dec through a 128-d ReLU hidden layer instead of one Linear
HP check on champion arch: mild regularization (weight_decay=1e-5, dropout_rate=0.1)
Give champion's enc4 dilation=2 for a wider receptive field right before the bottleneck
Reduce bottleneck_conv from two stacked 3x3x3 convs (64->128->128) to a single one (64->128), generalizing the SE-placement win (less unnecessary bottleneck-adjacent capacity)
Replace bottleneck_conv's two InstanceNorm3d with GroupNorm(8,128) to preserve inter-channel relative scale before the FC projection
Replace bottleneck_conv's plain conv stack with the existing ResConv3DBlock (same convs + same-stage residual add), extending the champion's own residual pattern to the bottleneck
